text:
amanda: quick sync 1 - need a tiny canonical error shape for SDK parity. keep compact by default.
jason: compact default + opt-in verbose via header `X-Error-Detail: verbose` sounds good. compact = code,status,(retry_after).
priya: agree. keys: code (namespaced), status, message (internal), user_message (friendly), retryable (bool), retry_after (sec|null), retry_hint, user_action, meta/docs_url.
lucas: explicit `retryable` so SDKs don't guess. mapping notes: 429 -> retryable=true unless set false; 5xx -> retryable=true; 4xx -> retryable=false unless hint present.
emily: sample app UX: show `user_message` in banner, collapsible details reveal `message` only when verbose. keep user_message <140 chars.
amanda: example verbose payload (as string for docs): { error: { code: "auth.token_expired", status: 401, message: "token expired at verifier step", user_message: "Session expired, please sign in.", user_action: "refresh_token", retryable: false, retry_after: null, retry_hint: "refresh_token", meta: "docs:/errors#auth.token_expired" } }
priya: i'll open the API PR to add `user_message`,`user_action`,`retryable`, and header support. tagging @jason for review.
jason: will add status->retry tests across SDKs. add parity harness in devex.
ci-bot: sample-apps/test-suite 1 failed (sdk-go error-shape test) https://ci.redwood.internal/2468
lucas: I'll fix go SDK to parse `retryable` correctly.
amanda: goal: land API + docs this week, SDK tests next sprint. updates in this thread only.
